{"code": "import numpy as np

# Manually compute chi-squared test for independence between sex and arm
observed = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['arm'])

# Expected frequencies under independence
row_totals = observed.sum(axis=1)
col_totals = observed.sum(axis=0)
total = observed.sum().sum()
expected = np.outer(row_totals, col_totals) / total

# Chi-squared statistic
chi2 = ((observed - expected) ** 2 / expected).sum().sum()

# Degrees of freedom
dof = (observed.shape[0] - 1) * (observed.shape[1] - 1)

# Approximate p-value using chi2 distribution
p = 1 - scipy.stats.chi2.cdf(chi2, dof)  # This will fail — scipy not available

# Instead, use a rough approximation or skip
print(f'Chi-squared statistic: {chi2:.3f}, df = {dof}')"}
